name: DETERQUIN
hero_sub_en: deterquin.com · Colombia · Cali · Circular economy · Stage: Seed · CT-WA-004
hero_sub_es: deterquin.com · Colombia · Cali · Economía circular · Etapa: Seed · CT-WA-004
pitch_en: Eco-friendly ultraconcentrated detergents and starch-based adhesives for industrial laundry and hospitality, cutting plastic via Eco Pacs format.
pitch_es: Detergentes ultraconcentrados eco-amigables y adhesivos a base de almidón para lavandería industrial y hostelería, reduciendo plástico con formato Eco Pacs.
cta_pitch_en: 360° cleaning and laundry programs with concentrated chemistry, technical support, and sustainability positioning for institutional clients.
cta_pitch_es: Programas 360° de limpieza y lavandería con química concentrada, soporte técnico y enfoque de sostenibilidad para clientes institucionales.
image_credits_en: Hero–CTA: marketing photos, deterquin.com (home slider, professional cleaning, Eco Pacs, eco adhesives, laundry, food-processing lines).
image_credits_es: Hero–CTA: fotos de marketing, deterquin.com (slider principal, limpieza profesional, Eco Pacs, eco-amigables, lavandería, alimentos y bebidas).

sections.head_en: Industrial cleaning and laundry rely on bulky plastic packaging and concentrated chemicals with high water-shipping footprint.
sections.head_es: La limpieza y lavandería industrial dependen de empaques plásticos voluminosos y químicos concentrados con alta huella logística de agua.
sections.body_en: DETERQUIN develops ultraconcentrated, eco-friendly detergents and starch-based adhesives, including Eco Pacs designed to reduce plastic waste in professional cleaning.
sections.body_es: DETERQUIN desarrolla detergentes ultraconcentrados eco-amigables y adhesivos a base de almidón, incluido Eco Pacs para reducir residuos plásticos en limpieza profesional.

steps.text_en: Ultraconcentrated detergents, professional cleaning programs, and starch-based eco adhesives for industry.
steps.text_es: Detergentes ultraconcentrados, programas de limpieza profesional y adhesivos eco a base de almidón para industria.

steps.text_en: Based in Cali, Colombia. Public site: deterquin.com.
steps.text_es: Con base en Cali, Colombia. Sitio público: deterquin.com.

cards.text_en: Profile synced from BookStack Startup Portfolio + public website.

cards.text_es: El sitio público cita 50.000 kg menos de plástico, 694.000 botellas menos y 101.000 kg menos de CO₂ (sin auditoría independiente aquí).
